changeSet.author: Oliver Lewington
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION payment_event_rank(p_type text) RETURNS int AS $$ BEGIN RETURN CASE p_type WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.extracted' THEN 1 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.enriched' THEN 2 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.paused.hold' THEN 3 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.paused.cross-border' THEN 4 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.paused.debt' THEN 5 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.warning.payment.debt.missing' THEN 6 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.debt.attached' THEN 7 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.paused.ledger' THEN 8 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.ledger.assigned' THEN 9 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.ledger.quality-check.pending' THEN 10 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.ledger.quality-check.failed' THEN 11 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.ledger.quality-check.passed' THEN 12 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.reset' THEN 13 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.processed' THEN 14 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.warning.processing.failed' THEN 15 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.submitted' THEN 16 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.warning.bank.missing' THEN 17 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.processed.no.further.action' THEN 18 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.acknowledged' THEN 19 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.warning.settlement.unsettled' THEN 20 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.settled' THEN 21 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.suppressed.recovery' THEN 22 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.duplicate' THEN 23 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.warning.duplicate.payment' THEN 24 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.warning.payment.rejected' THEN 25 WHEN 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.warning.payment.dax.rejected' THEN 26 ELSE 0 END; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;

changeSet.author: Oliver Lewington
changeSet.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT p."partitionKey" AS frn, split_part(p."rowKey", '|', 1) AS "correlationId", p.type, p."time", ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p."partitionKey", split_part(p."rowKey", '|', 1) ORDER BY payment_event_rank(p.type) DESC, p."time" DESC ) AS rn FROM payments p WHERE p.category = 'frn' ) UPDATE payment_frn_events pfe SET type = r.type, "lastUpdated" = r."time" FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = 1 AND pfe.frn = r.frn AND pfe."correlationId" = r."correlationId" AND pfe.type IS DISTINCT FROM r.type;

changeSet.author: Oliver Lewington
changeSet.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT p."partitionKey" AS "batchName", p.data->>'frn' AS frn, p.type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p."partitionKey", p.data->>'frn' ORDER BY payment_event_rank(p.type) DESC, p."time" DESC ) AS rn FROM payments p WHERE p.category = 'batch' ) UPDATE payment_batch_events pbe SET type = r.type FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = 1 AND pbe."batchName" = r."batchName" AND pbe.frn = r.frn AND pbe.type IS DISTINCT FROM r.type;
